'''Ben Tippie''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Genghis Con tournament (17 February, evening)]] on 17 February 2001 with [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|ROPs]], according to Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1811">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-denver-co-genghis-con-2-17-01-nightfalld1811/ denver-co-genghis-con-2-17-01-nightfall], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 27 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-27-denver-co-genghis-con-2-17-01-nightfalld1811/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
